question: Are other animals permissible as offerings according to the practitioner's wish?
premises: The preceding verses prescribe specific animals for offering.
The verse permits other animals as well.
The choice follows the practitioner's wish.
inference: Therefore, beyond the listed animals, additional animals may be offered in accordance with the practitioner's wish.
uncertainties: Whether any restrictions limit which other animals may be chosen is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: One may also offer other animals, according to the wish of the practitioner.
